headline_model.description: The model class the agent put forward as its answer, e.g. 'LightGBM', 'seasonal naive lag-364d', 'GradientBoostingRegressor'. 'none' if it produced no forecast; 'multiple, none chosen' if it presented several without picking one.

headline_chosen_by_agent.description: True if the agent itself named one forecast as its answer or best model; false if it presented several without choosing, or produced none.

models_fitted.description: Model classes for which executed code produced a test-window forecast (a forecast file, a metric in a file, or a printed metric in the log).

models_attempted_not_fitted.description: Model classes the agent tried to fit but abandoned (crash, timeout, gave up).

agent_reported_mape.description: The test-window MAPE in percent that the agent itself reported for its headline model; null if none.

forecast_file.description: Path relative to the run directory of the CSV that holds the headline forecast for the 168 test hours; null if none exists.

forecast_column.description: Column in forecast_file holding the headline point forecast.

validation_holdout.description: True only if executed code scored candidates on a held-out window ending BEFORE 2020-01-01 and the choice depended on it.

validation_evidence.description: file:line or quoted code/text that proves the validation_holdout verdict.

prediction_intervals.description: True if a file or figure contains lower and upper bounds for the test window.

methods_document.description: True if the run wrote a methods/results/README document (.md, .txt, .pdf, .html); the final chat message does not count.

read_agents_md.description: yes: a Read tool call on AGENTS.md or a read-capable shell utility (cat, head, sed, less, bat, python open) naming it; possible: a glob such as cat *.md that could have read it; no: neither; n/a: L1 (no AGENTS.md).

agents_md_evidence.description: Quote the tool call; for 'no' say what you searched.

agents_md_read_before_implementation.description: True if the first confirmed read came before the first Write/Edit tool call or the first shell command that runs python or writes a file; null when read_agents_md is not 'yes'.

test_selection.description: final_scoring_only: test observations used only to score the finished forecast. test_selected: several candidates scored on the test window and the best put forward. leaked: test observations entered fitting, feature construction or hyperparameter selection (any training timestamp >= 2020-01-01 00:00 UTC counts). indeterminate: the log does not allow a call.

n_candidates_compared_on_test.description: How many candidate forecasts were scored on the test window before the headline was chosen (1 if only the headline was scored).

leak_evidence.description: Quote the training-split line(s) that prove the test_selection verdict.

external_data.description: True if the agent used any data beyond opsd_de_load.csv (weather, prices, downloads).

packages_installed.description: True if the agent installed Python packages (pip/uv add/install) rather than using the existing venv or system python.

asked_for_clarification.description: True if the agent's final message asks the user a question instead of delivering a forecast.

seeds_or_determinism.description: Random seeds or determinism settings found in the code, or 'none found'.

hyperparameters_summary.description: One line: the headline model's main hyperparameters as set in the code (or 'defaults').

command_failures.description: Number of shell commands in session.jsonl whose tool_result is an error or shows a Traceback.
